# Introduction

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Introduction

In an adjacency list representation of a graph, we associate each vertex with a collection of all its adjacent vertices. For example,

![A Graph](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, the adjacent vertices of each vertex are:

| Vertex | Adjacent Vertices |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 3, 4 |
| 2 | 4 |
| 3 | 1, 4 |
| 4 | 1, 2, 3 |

Now, let's create an adjacency list using this information.

![Adjacency List](data:image/png;base64,)
